dedupe_keys.name: fdi fishing fleet inputs for fuel cross analysis

description: The CNR fisheries energy research team publishes archived Fisheries Dependent Information inputs for scaling vessel-fuel estimates to fleet segments. The own page identifies annual 2019 effort and landings drawn from the European Commission JRC's aggregated member-state collection. Four Excel workbooks provide capacity, catches, effort and code definitions by country. The Figshare archive is free under CC BY 4.0. Its documented use matches landings to effort and length-based fuel estimates to calculate fuel intensity and carbon footprints. These inputs can support fishing-fleet demand and emissions simulations alongside maritime context from data-unctadstat-maritime-transport. A caveat is that this fixed extract is distinct from the annually updated upstream FDI service. Fleet-segment aggregation and inferred fuel use should not be treated as direct measurements from every vessel. The landing page does not enumerate every workbook country or row, and no workbook was downloaded.
